Title: Mizan: Quran & Prayer Times
Short description: Holy Quran, prayer times, Qibla compass, adhkar, and inheritance calculator.
Full description:
Mizan is a comprehensive, modern Islamic toolkit designed for daily use. Lightweight, elegant, completely ad-free, and designed to work 100% offline without requiring internet access.

• High-quality audio recitation support.
• Quick verse search, reading bookmarks, streak tracking, and focus mode.

• Detailed breakdown of shares, Awl, and Radd.

💰 Zakat & Kaffarah Calculators:
• Calculate Zakat on wealth, gold, silver, investments, and trade.
• Zakat al-Fitr, fasting compensation (Fidya), and expiations (Kaffarah).

📅 Hijri Calendar & Islamic Events:
• Umm al-Qura Hijri-Gregorian converter.
• Countdown to Ramadan, Eid, and sacred Islamic dates.

🔒 100% Offline & Private:
• Completely free and permanently ad-free.
• Zero tracking, zero telemetry, and zero data collection.
